condition: Lab results explanation, newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes and high cholesterol

patient_persona.description: Encik Faizal bin Rahim, 44, male, government office clerk in Putrajaya, came for a company health screening. Surprised, a little defensive about his diet.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lau Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP at a Putrajaya clinic. Friendly, direct; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Faizal, blood test results dah keluar. Ada beberapa benda saya nak bincang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada masalah ke, doktor? Saya rasa sihat je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: HbA1c encik 7.8 peratus. Normal bawah 5.7. Gula puasa pula 8.4. Dua-dua ni menunjukkan encik ada kencing manis, type 2 diabetes.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kencing manis? Saya tak ada simptom apa-apa pun, doktor. Feel okay je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ramai tak ada simptom awal. But if left untreated, boleh rosakkan mata, buah pinggang, saraf dan jantung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kolesterol pula, LDL 4.6 mmol per litre. Untuk pesakit diabetes, kita nak bawah 2.6. Trigliserida pun tinggi, 3.1.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya memang suka makan nasi lemak dan minum teh tarik, every morning. Tapi ayah saya dulu pun kencing manis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sejarah keluarga memang tingkatkan risiko. Buah pinggang encik normal, eGFR 95. Hati pun OK, ALT 38.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jadi kena makan ubat seumur hidup ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We start with metformin 500mg, twice a day after meals. Atorvastatin 20mg malam untuk kolesterol.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau saya kurus dan jaga makan, boleh stop ubat nanti?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada yang boleh kurangkan ubat bila berat turun banyak. Target turun lima hingga tujuh kilo dulu. Encik sekarang 86 kilo.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Senaman apa yang sesuai? Saya kerja office, duduk je depan computer.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Brisk walking thirty minutes, lima hari seminggu. Tukar teh tarik ke teh kosong, nasi separuh pinggan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Metformin tu ada kesan sampingan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Perut tak selesa atau cirit-birit sikit, minggu pertama. Take it after food untuk kurangkan. Kita ulang blood test three months lagi.

patient_persona.description: Chong Yee Mun, 38, female, kindergarten owner in Seremban; tiredness, weight gain, and hair loss. Chatty, somewhat relieved to have an explanation.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Rahman bin Said, Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Seremban clinic. Methodical; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yee Mun, your thyroid test results are back. TSH is 18.5, quite high. Free T4 is low, 7.2. 甲状腺功能低下, hypothyroidism.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 甲状腺？难怪我最近很累，头发一直掉，weight 也增加了五公斤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, all those fit. 还有很怕冷, constipation, dry skin?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对对对，我在 aircon 房里一直穿 jacket，同事都笑我。大便也三天一次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The thyroid antibodies are positive. So this is Hashimoto's thyroiditis, 自身免疫的病. Common in women.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Autoimmune？会不会很严重？会变成 cancer 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not cancer, 不是癌症. It's very treatable. You take a thyroid hormone tablet, levothyroxine, to replace what your body is not making.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要吃一辈子吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually yes, lifelong. 可是只是一粒小小的药, once a day, very safe when the dose is correct.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Start 50mcg every morning, 空肚子, thirty minutes before breakfast. 不要和 calcium or iron tablets 一起吃.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我早上都喝 kopi 配面包。要等半个小时？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, 等三十分钟. Coffee reduces absorption. Or you can take it at bedtime, three hours after dinner.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我的体重会不会降回来？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some of the weight, especially fluid, will come down. 可是 diet 和 exercise 还是很重要.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我们打算明年要生第二胎，会有 problem 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you mention. Before pregnancy, TSH should be well controlled. 怀孕的时候 dose 通常要加, so tell us early.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我明白了。什么时候再验血？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Six weeks later we check TSH again and adjust the dose. Energy usually improves in a few weeks.

condition: Lab results explanation, iron deficiency anaemia needing GI work-up

patient_persona.description: Mr. Jeganathan a/l Murugiah, 61, male, retired estate supervisor in Sungai Petani, Kedah; breathless on exertion. Calm, polite, Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Nor Aishah binti Abdullah, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Kedah klinik kesihatan. Serious, careful; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Jeganathan, your blood results show anaemia, kurang darah. Your haemoglobin is 8.9. For a man, normal is above 13.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That's why I'm so penat, doctor. Walking to the kedai also I need to stop and rest.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The red cells are small, and ferritin, your iron store, is very low, only 6. So this is iron deficiency anaemia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I thought maybe I eat less meat. Since my wife passed, I just makan simple food, nasi dengan sayur je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Diet can contribute. But in a man of your age, the most common reason is slow blood loss from the gut. Sometimes from an ulcer, sometimes from a growth in the bowel.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Growth? You mean cancer ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm not saying it is cancer, but we must rule it out. Have you noticed black stools, blood in stools, or change in bowel habit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Stool sometimes dark, but I thought because of the iron tonic from the kedai ubat. No blood I can see.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any weight loss? Stomach pain?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lost maybe three kilo in six months. Stomach sometimes pedih, I take antacid.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Do you take painkillers often, like for joint pain?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, for my knee, I buy the arthritis pills from pharmacy, diclofenac I think. Almost every day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Diclofenac can cause stomach ulcers and bleeding. Tolong stop ubat tu. I'll give paracetamol for the knee instead.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm referring you for scope, both from top, gastroscopy, and from below, colonoscopy. Urgent appointment, dalam dua minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, doctor. Meanwhile I just makan ubat besi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, ferrous fumarate 200mg twice a day. Also omeprazole 20mg daily to protect your stomach. Kalau muntah darah or black tarry stool with pening, go to emergency.

condition: Lab results explanation, chronic kidney disease stage 3 in a hypertensive patient

patient_persona.description: Puan Habsah binti Othman, 66, female, retired kindergarten cook in Kuala Terengganu; hypertension for fifteen years. Gentle, worried about dialysis.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Eugene Teh Wei Liang, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer at a Terengganu hospital medical clinic. Calm, reassuring; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik Habsah, keputusan darah dah ada. Buah pinggang mak cik kurang berfungsi sikit. eGFR 42.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Buah pinggang? Kena cuci darah ke, doktor? Kakak saya dulu kena dialysis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak, mak cik. eGFR 42 ni tahap tiga. Dialysis biasanya bila bawah 10 atau 15. Masih jauh, dan kita nak jaga supaya tak sampai ke situ.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Kenapa jadi macam ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Darah tinggi yang lama, lima belas tahun, boleh rosakkan buah pinggang perlahan-lahan. Protein dalam air kencing pun ada, ACR 45.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Macam mana nak jaga buah pinggang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pertama, tekanan darah. Hari ni 152 atas 90, tinggi. Target bawah 130 atas 80. Saya tambah losartan 50mg sekali sehari, dia lindungi buah pinggang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makan ubat tahan sakit untuk lutut boleh lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat macam ibuprofen dan diclofenac, jangan. Dia rosakkan buah pinggang. Paracetamol lebih selamat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makanan pula, doktor? Saya suka ikan masin dengan budu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Garam kena kurangkan, sebab it raises blood pressure. Ikan masin, budu, keropok, sos, makan sikit je.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Air kena minum banyak ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Minum biasa, jangan terlalu kurang. Avoid traditional medicine or jamu yang kita tak tahu kandungan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Potassium saya OK ke? Doktor dulu cakap pasal potassium.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Potassium 4.8, masih normal. Tapi dengan losartan, kita check balik dua minggu lagi. Kalau naik, kita ubah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya ikut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Datang balik dua minggu untuk ujian darah, bawa bacaan tekanan darah rumah. Kita buat plan panjang dengan pakar buah pinggang kalau perlu.

condition: Lab results explanation, abnormal liver function in fatty liver disease

patient_persona.description: Mr. Tan Wei Liang, 39, male, IT project manager in Johor Bahru; screening showed raised liver enzymes. Busy, analytical, eats out often.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kavitha a/p Rajagopal, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, gastroenterology medical officer at a JB hospital clinic. Precise, friendly; English with Mandarin words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Tan, your liver enzymes are raised. ALT is 112, normal below 40. The ultrasound shows fatty liver, 脂肪肝.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 脂肪肝……我很少喝 alcohol 啊，一个月一两次而已。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This is non-alcoholic fatty liver, now called MASLD, 跟体重、血糖和 cholesterol 有关. Your BMI is 30, and waist 102 cm.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我知道我胖了，工作忙，每天都吃外面的，晚上还吃 supper。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your hepatitis B and C tests are negative. Good. The FibroScan shows mild stiffness, 还是早期. No cirrhosis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Cirrhosis 就是肝硬化，对吗？我会不会变成那样？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If nothing changes, some people progress over years. 可是你现在这个 stage, it's very reversible.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要吃什么药？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No specific medicine needed now. The best treatment is weight loss. 减七到十 percent, around six to nine kilos, and liver fat drops a lot.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 九公斤……有点难，可是我试试看。要怎么开始？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cut sugary drinks first, 不要喝 bubble tea 了. Less white rice and noodles at night, no supper. Exercise 150 minutes a week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我早上可以喝 kopi 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Actually, black coffee without sugar may help the liver. Kopi O kosong is fine.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 supplement 呢？我同事推荐 milk thistle。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Evidence is weak, 省点钱吧. Avoid unknown herbal products, some can harm the liver.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，明白。什么时候复诊？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Six months, repeat blood test and FibroScan. Also your sugar is borderline, HbA1c 6.2, so weight loss helps both.

condition: Referral to breast surgeon for a breast lump

patient_persona.description: Ms. Angeline Joseph, 41, female, bank relationship manager in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; found a lump in her left breast. Composed but frightened, Sabahan English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Norliza binti Ahmad Tajuddin, Malay woman in her 50s, family medicine specialist at a Kota Kinabalu klinik kesihatan. Calm, honest; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Angeline, you said you found a lump. When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About three weeks ago, in the shower. I thought maybe related to my period, but it's still there, doctor. Tak sakit pun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Has it changed in size? Any nipple discharge, skin changes, or lumps in the armpit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I don't think bigger. No discharge. Skin looks normal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any family history of breast or ovarian cancer?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My aunt, my mother's sister, had breast cancer at 50. She's still alive.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll examine you now, with the nurse present, ada misi teman. There's a firm lump about two centimetres, upper outer left breast. Agak melekat, not very mobile. No armpit lumps.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is it bad? Please be honest.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I can't tell for sure just by examination. Many lumps are benign, like fibroadenoma. But because it's firm and a bit fixed, it needs proper assessment quickly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So what's next?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm referring you to the breast surgical clinic at the hospital, urgent referral, dalam masa dua minggu. They'll do ultrasound, mammogram, and a biopsy if needed.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Two weeks. Can it be faster? I cannot sleep thinking about this, risau sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya call the clinic myself hari ni and ask. It's called triple assessment: examination, imaging, and biopsy. Results usually one week after.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Should I tell my family now or wait?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's your choice. Some people find it helps to have someone with them at the appointment. Tak perlu hadapi seorang diri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. My sister can come with me. Terima kasih, doktor, for taking it seriously.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Of course. If the hospital hasn't called in three days, call me. Here's the referral letter.

condition: Referral to paediatric developmental clinic for speech delay

patient_persona.description: Puan Suraya binti Mokhtar, 31, female, mother of Adam Hakimi, 2 years 6 months; online seller in Kajang. Worried, defensive about screen time, speaks quickly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chin Kok Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Kajang klinik kesihatan. Gentle, observant; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Suraya, dalam buku rekod, nurse tulis Adam belum bercakap banyak. Boleh cerita?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia cakap dua tiga perkataan je, doktor. Mama, susu, nak. Sepupu dia umur sama dah cakap full sentences.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia faham arahan tak? Kalau puan kata "ambil kasut", dia buat?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kadang-kadang buat, kadang-kadang buat tak tahu. Bila panggil nama pun, dia jarang pandang, no eye contact.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia pointing dengan jari tak, kalau nak sesuatu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak berapa. Dia tarik tangan saya ke benda tu. Dia suka susun kereta mainan jadi barisan panjang, in one straight line.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berapa lama dia tengok skrin sehari? Telefon, TV, tablet?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Banyak jugak lah, doktor. Saya kerja online, jadi saya bagi dia tengok YouTube. Mungkin lima enam jam sehari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Too much screen time can delay speech. Tapi selain tu, tanda-tanda lain macam jarang pandang bila dipanggil, tak tunjuk, dan susun barang, saya nak pakar nilai lebih lanjut.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pakar? Maksud doktor anak saya autism ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya tak boleh cakap sekarang. Ini saringan awal je. Saya rujuk ke klinik pembangunan kanak-kanak di hospital, dan ujian pendengaran sekali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pendengaran? Dia boleh dengar bunyi TV dari jauh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang partial hearing loss pun boleh lambatkan cakap. Kita nak pastikan semua. The earlier the intervention, the better.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sementara tunggu, apa saya boleh buat?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kurangkan skrin, bawah satu jam sehari. Bercakap dengan dia sepanjang hari, main bersama, baca buku bergambar, nyanyi lagu kanak-kanak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya rasa bersalah, doktor. Saya sibuk sangat dengan business online.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan datang hari ni, itu langkah penting. Temujanji hospital biasanya dalam sebulan. Nurse akan bagi surat rujukan sekarang.

condition: Referral to ophthalmology for diabetic retinopathy

patient_persona.description: Mr. Ong Chee Keong, 58, male, taxi driver in Ipoh with diabetes for twelve years; retinal photo shows changes. Worried about his driving licence, Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Fatimah Az-Zahra binti Ismail, Malay woman in her 30s, family medicine doctor at an Ipoh klinik kesihatan. Clear, empathetic; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Ong, your eye photo from last month, 眼底照片, shows some changes from diabetes. It's called diabetic retinopathy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 眼睛？可是我看东西还可以啊，开 teksi 都没问题。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: In early stage, vision can still be okay. 可是照片看到 small bleeding and some swelling near the centre of the retina. That can affect vision later.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会瞎吗？我还要 drive 养家。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If treated early, blindness can usually be prevented. That's why I'm referring you to the eye specialist, 眼科, at the hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他们会做什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: They'll check more carefully, maybe a scan called OCT. 治疗可能是 injections into the eye, or laser.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 打针在眼睛里？天啊……sure 很痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sounds scary, but the eye is numbed first. 很多 patients 说不痛, just pressure.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your HbA1c is 9.4. 控制糖分很重要 to slow the eye damage. Also blood pressure, 148 over 90 today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我开 teksi，常常在外面吃，又要喝 teh ais 提神。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Try teh O kosong, or plain water. We'll adjust your medicines. I'll add gliclazide MR 60mg in the morning with your metformin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我的 licence 会不会被拿掉？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Driving depends on your vision test. For now your vision is 6/9, 开车还可以. The eye doctor will advise further.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好……那 appointment 什么时候？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I've marked it as early review, within four weeks. If vision suddenly blurred or you see a curtain, 马上去 eye emergency.

condition: Referral to cardiology for exertional chest pain

patient_persona.description: Mr. Siva a/l Ganesan, 52, male, secondary school PE teacher in Klang; chest tightness when climbing stairs. Fit-looking, a bit in denial, Manglish.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Choon Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, GP at a Klang family clinic. Direct, practical; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, lately when I climb stairs to the third floor at school, my chest feels ketat. Rehat dua minit, dia hilang. I think just not fit already lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How long has this been happening?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About one month. Before this, I can run with the students no problem, lari satu padang pun okay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Does the tightness go to your arm, jaw or back? Any sweating or breathlessness with it?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes the left arm feels heavy, berat macam batu. A bit sweaty also.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any smoking, diabetes, high blood pressure, cholesterol? Family history of heart attack?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I stopped smoking five years ago. My father had heart attack at 55. Cholesterol I never check.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your ECG at rest is normal. But the story sounds like angina, jantung tak cukup darah bila buat kerja berat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But I'm a PE teacher, doctor. I'm fit, macam mana boleh jadi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Fitness helps, but it doesn't cancel family history and smoking history. I'm referring you to cardiology for a stress test or CT coronary angiogram.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Urgent ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, within two weeks. Meanwhile, start aspirin 100mg once daily and atorvastatin 40mg at night. And I'll give you GTN spray.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: GTN is for what?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If chest pain comes, stop, duduk, one spray under the tongue. If still pain after five minutes, spray again and call 999. Jangan drive sendiri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I still teach PE? Sports day coming, hari sukan sekolah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No running or heavy exertion until cardiology clears you. Boleh mengajar, tapi supervise sahaja. I'll give you a letter for your principal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay lah, doctor. My wife sure will marah me for not coming earlier.

condition: Referral to ENT for persistent neck lump and nasal symptoms

patient_persona.description: Mr. Chan Kok Onn, 47, male, seafood restaurant owner in Sekinchan, Selangor; painless neck lump and blood-stained nasal mucus. Busy, casual, Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Iman binti Harith, Malay woman in her 30s, family medicine doctor at a Kuala Selangor klinik kesihatan. Careful, gentle; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我脖子这边有一粒东西，不痛，两个月了。我太太一直叫我来 check。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for coming, Mr. Chan. 我摸一下. Right side of the neck, about three centimetres, firm, not tender. Has it grown?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好像大了一点点。我以为是淋巴发炎，吃了几天 antibiotic 都没有小。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any nose symptoms? 鼻塞, blood in the mucus, ringing or blocked feeling in one ear?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啊，早上擤鼻涕有一点 blood，右边耳朵也有点塞塞的，好像在水里。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Anyone in the family had nose cancer, nasopharyngeal cancer, 鼻咽癌?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我舅舅以前是鼻咽癌走的……医生，你是说我也是？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I cannot say yet. But the neck lump with blood-stained mucus and blocked ear, 加上家族史, must be checked properly by ENT specialist.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我会不会是 cancer……我店里还要做生意，孩子还在读书。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know this is frightening, 很可怕. Nasopharyngeal cancer is quite common in Chinese men in Malaysia, and when found early, treatment results are good.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那要做什么检查？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: ENT will look inside the nose with a small camera, nasoendoscopy, 有需要的话 take a biopsy. Also a blood test called EBV.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 什么时候可以看？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm sending an urgent referral to the ENT clinic at the state hospital, 通常两个礼拜内. I'll call them today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我会去。这段时间要注意什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If the nose bleeds a lot, or you have double vision, severe headache, go to emergency. Also, try to cut down on salted fish, 咸鱼 eat less.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 咸鱼……我们 restaurant 天天都有。好，我会少吃。Thank you, 医生。
